name: Template Block
description: Provides a block plugin that renders a Twig template file chosen by its suggestion name.
project_description:
Template Block provides a simple way for site builders to place Twig templates as blocks. 

 Post-Installation 
 
 Place a Template Block block somewhere on your site, e.g. via Block Layout, Layout Builder, etc. 
 Create the appropriate template in your site's theme. Your template's name will be something like template-block--MY-TEMPLATE.html.twig . (You choose the value of MY-TEMPLATE in step 1.) 
 Clear your site's cache and profit. 😎 
 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 Install Twig Tweak to take your Template Block blocks to the next level. 

 Back to top
